scientific_method.core_mechanism: A frozen clean-view X-VLA teacher supervises a wrist-dropout student at the real action-hidden and continuous action-chunk outputs. A zero-initialized action-hidden residual and a training-only cross-view wrist-latent decoder share a bottleneck, so reconstruction shapes the deployable action representation without inserting a predicted wrist token or image into the policy stream.
scientific_method.primary_objective: action-semantic distillation composite over action hidden states, translation, rotation, and raw gripper margins
scientific_method.single_auxiliary_objective: clean wrist-view Florence2 latent reconstruction from the shared dropout action-hidden trunk
scientific_method.narrow_claim: deployment-clean adaptation of a frozen multi-view VLA to complete wrist loss with action-chunk semantic alignment, separate raw gripper-margin preservation, training-only cross-view reconstruction, exact clean bypass, and no teacher, retrieval, generator, or reconstructed input at deployment

teacher_student_tensors.teacher_action_hidden: h_teacher = clean model.transformer.norm output before action_decoder, shape [B,30,1024]
teacher_student_tensors.teacher_raw_action: v_teacher = clean action_decoder output before action_space.postprocess, shape [B,30,20]
teacher_student_tensors.student_base_action_hidden: h_dropout = wrist-dropout model.transformer.norm output before adapter, shape [B,30,1024]
teacher_student_tensors.student_action_hidden: h_student = h_dropout + zero-initialized bounded residual, shape [B,30,1024]

paired_training_forward.teacher_input: matched current agent view plus valid synchronized current wrist view and identical language/proprioception
paired_training_forward.student_input: matched current agent view plus processor-equivalent black wrist pixels, unchanged official sample image_mask [true,true,false], identical language/proprioception, and missing_indicator=1
paired_training_forward.wrist_dropout_implementation: preserve the frozen mask_1_in_hand_dropout condition exactly: replace only wrist image_input[1] with the X-VLA-processor black-frame tensor; do not change image_mask
paired_training_forward.noise_coupling: teacher and student receive identical x_t and t for every exposure
paired_training_forward.t_schedule: within every effective batch of eight, t_j=(j+0.5)/8 for j=0..7
paired_training_forward.epsilon_schedule: arm-independent deterministic normal tensor keyed by SHA256(seed, exposure_ordinal, task, demo, reader_position)

normalization_calibration.source: fixed discovery calibration rows: demo 0 at reader positions 0,9,18,27 for each of three tasks
normalization_calibration.rule: Each teacher-agreement MSE is divided by the corresponding frozen Base-dropout-versus-clean-teacher MSE; reconstruction MSE is divided by zero-fill wrist-latent MSE. Denominators use the listed floors and are frozen in the Stage 0 preregistration before optimizer steps.

hidden.scope: all 30 action positions and all 1024 hidden dimensions

generic_dropout_supervision.formula: position_loss/500 + rotate6D_loss/10 + gripper_loss from official EE6DActionSpace.compute_loss(v_student, demonstration_action)

clean_bypass.deployment_behavior: when the wrist view is valid, do not activate the transformer.norm hook
clean_bypass.module_guard: an all-zero missing_indicator returns the original hidden tensor object before any trainable operation

dropout_path: official X-VLA forward_vlm with processor-equivalent black wrist pixels and the unchanged official image_mask
shared_down and shared_core on transformer.norm action hidden

stage_b.failure_indicator_assumption: the simulated camera driver exposes only a current wrist-failure/stale-frame indicator; it exposes no task outcome, simulator state, reset identity, or future information
stage_b.initial_allocation: four tasks x fifteen identities; deterministic task-balanced Latin-square assignment gives twenty paired rows per wrist-failure condition
stage_b.single_expansion_allocation: add five identities per task using the preregistered deterministic condition assignment, preserving task balance and near-equal condition balance

stage_b.access_rule: outcomes remain inaccessible until Stage A supports Stage B and a separately hashed Stage B manifest

training_budget.schedule: 8-step linear warmup followed by cosine decay to 0.00003 at step 128
training_budget.microbatch_selection: largest first-prefix-stable candidate with CUDA reserved <=88%, system RAM <=82%, no research-induced pagefile growth, finite loss/gradients, optimizer step, and checkpoint capability; stop after first unsafe size

practical_effect_rule.threshold_formula: for each measure, improvement must be at least 5% relative and at least max(absolute_floor, 10 * measured_fixed_seed_repeat_noise)
practical_effect_rule.full_vs_no_reconstruction: full must pass the threshold on at least one co-primary measure
practical_effect_rule.full_vs_generic: full must pass the same threshold on at least one co-primary measure or Stage 0 returns STAGE0_GENERIC_ADAPTATION_EXPLAINS_GAIN
practical_effect_rule.other_measure_nonregression: no other co-primary measure may worsen by more than max(2% relative, 10 * measured_fixed_seed_repeat_noise)
practical_effect_rule.discrete_gripper_nonregression: full may not add a validation gripper disagreement relative to no-reconstruction or generic control
practical_effect_rule.reconstruction_mechanism: full wrist-latent validation MSE must be at most 0.95 times no-reconstruction overall and lower on at least two of three tasks
practical_effect_rule.numerical_noise_values_frozen_in: Stage 0 preregistration before any optimizer step

required: checkpoint write and exact disk reload
safety_and_validity.smoothness_envelope: per-dimension 99th percentile of absolute adjacent-step translation and rotation deltas on fixed clean-teacher discovery calibration chunks, plus 10 times repeated-forward noise; frozen before optimization

latency_and_memory_metrics.inference_timing: 10 warmup and 100 measured fixed-input queries; median, p95, and mean milliseconds for total query and adapter-only CUDA-event time
latency_and_memory_metrics.pareto_thresholds_deferred_until: separate Stage A manifest before Stage A outcomes
